dct_description_sm: The 1993 Canadian Election Survey (CES) included five surveys - two surveys for the Referendum on the Charlottetown Consitutional Accord held on October 26, 1992, and three surveys were for the 1993 Federal Election on October 25, 1993. The Pre-Referendum Survey was completed between September 24-October 25, 1992; the Post-Referendum survey was completed between October 31-December 2, 1992. The Campaign Period Survey was completed between September 10-October 24, 1993; the Post-Election Survey was completed between October 27-November 21, 1993; and the Mail-back Survey was competed between November 25-March 5, 1993.
